name: prop-bus
about: Nest Egg Run's bus (second version, after the final review found the first one's round roof and window band too close to a famous German microbus): a long flat-sided coach with a raked wedge front, a flush band of windows lit magenta, six wheels. Tripo v3.1 at its standard (low-credit) settings from concept traffic-bus-b-sd-0, one attempt; mirrored to exact symmetry.
